---
name: Model Request
about: Ask for a model to be added to the catalog or for a new build of an existing model
title: "[Model] "
labels: feature
assignees: ''
---

## Which model do you need?

Link the official model card, checkpoint, or repository, and name the exact variant (size, input resolution, dataset).

## What will you use it for?

Describe the task and the application, and who is affected.

## Which builds would solve the problem?

Name the precision (for example BF16 or INT8) and any performance or accuracy you need, when known.

## Current workaround

Describe any model you use instead or any attempt to compile it yourself, and where it falls short.

## Additional context (optional)

Link the model's license and related issues. Redact credentials, private URLs, and customer data.
